headline: "The State Must Take Its Hand Out of People's Pockets", Says Liberal Initiative Leader
summary: Liberal Initiative leader Mariana Leitão called on the state to reduce its burden on people and backed a proposal allowing 30 cents less per litre of fuel. The statement was made on 19 September.
why: Fuel taxes make up a large share of pump prices in Portugal, so changes to them affect transport costs, inflation and fuel retail margins.
